name: DisplayManager
author: Annerose
description: Manages the game's display: crisp integer/fit/custom scaling in true exclusive fullscreen (native desktop resolution, low-latency direct-flip present), with Point, Linear, tunable sharp-bilinear and xBR filters, plus Auto (sharp-bilinear and sharp character/stage sprites, tuned per output size), and optional MSAA; window sizing (drag or Alt+1..6) with the same filters in windowed mode, spawn position, background color, live filter/sharpness hotkeys with on-screen readout, and persisted settings. Use either this or WindowResizer, never both. See DisplayManager.ini.
